name: iris-mcp
description: Five MCP servers for InterSystems IRIS (development, administration, data, interoperability and operations) and the IRIS MCP skills pack. This is an independent community project. It is not made, endorsed or supported by InterSystems.

iris_host.title: IRIS host
iris_host.description: Host name of the IRIS web server (a bare host name, not a URL).

iris_port.title: IRIS web port
iris_port.description: Port of the IRIS web server (the Management Portal port).

iris_namespace.title: IRIS namespace
iris_namespace.description: Namespace the servers work in by default.

iris_https.title: Use HTTPS
iris_https.description: Connect to the IRIS web server over HTTPS.

iris_username.title: IRIS user name
iris_username.description: The IRIS user the servers connect as.

iris_password.title: IRIS password
iris_password.description: The password of that IRIS user. Claude Code keeps it in the system keychain.
